thread:
maria_ml: Heads-up — after landing the q4b-v2 build on staging I ran the benchmark sweep and the long-tail promptset (promptbank/longtail-v2) shows a quality drop vs float. median F1 0.71 -> 0.63 on our golden anchors. :frowning:
lee_labelops: oof. is that across all domains or concentrated? can you paste the failure examples? :eyes:
maria_ml: mostly multi-step instructions and code-generation-ish prompts. short repro: model emits truncated completions or repeats. evalbot: run finished — summary: q4b-v2 vs float baseline on longtail-v2: P50 F1 delta -0.08, worst buckets: code-snippets, multi-turn clarifications. full metrics posted here: https://dash.internal/runs/7452
anya_research: could this be tokenization/quant mismatch? last time q4b introduced a token align shift for rare tokens when tokenizer v1 vs v2 differed.
zach_platform: FYI the new serving kernel uses the tokenizer shard from model package; if package included tokenizer v2 we may be mixing with upstream dedupe artifacts.
lee_labelops: we need to surface a small micro-golden with the regression examples so labelers can relabel and we can check if it's annotation flip or model error. suggest 50-100 examples.
maria_ml: agreed. I'll extract 120 failure cases (stratified by intent) and push to s3://redwood-dev/curation/microgold/q4b-v2-1758.jsonl
maria_ml: small eval command I ran (share for reproducibility):
```
python tools/eval_harness.py \
  --model q4b-v2 \
  --prompts promptbank/longtail-v2.jsonl \
  --golden curation/goldsets/longtail-anchor.jsonl \
  --out results/q4b-v2-longtail.json
```
lee_labelops: can labelops pick this up tomorrow AM. note: when you create the microgold please include the tokenizer-normalized text and raw source; labelers need both for de-dup context.
anya_research: also run dedupe with tokenizer v2, I suspect our older hash pipeline used byte-level hashing that drifted after quantization changed some preprocessing. quick patch to test:
```
./dedupe --input longtail-v2.jsonl --tokenizer v2 --min-sim 0.95 --out deduped-v2.jsonl
```
zach_platform: I'll wire a one-off job to re-run dedupe with tokenizer v2 on the samplebank and push artifacts to the curation bucket. ETA 2h.
lee_labelops: when we onboard labelers for microgold, reduce batch size to 10 and mark "uncertain" guidance for partial completions. we'll include a few clear passes/fails as examples.
maria_ml: plan: (1) push microgold (120 examples) + dedupe-v2 output (2) labelops relabel 120 -> 24h turnaround (3) rerun eval harness with relabeled goldset (4) provide canary to staging traffic. timeline ~48h. sound ok?
anya_research: yes. also add a small eval that compares token-level repetition rate and avg completion length — that will tell us if it's truncation or hallucination.
lee_labelops: I'll create the labeler ticket and a quick rubric. tagging @zach_platform for the dedupe artifact link once ready. :white_check_mark:
evalbot: scheduled re-run queued — will run after new goldset is uploaded and post a summary in this thread.
maria_ml: thanks team. once we confirm it's a model regression we can try a fallback policy (serve float for code prompts) while we iterate on quantization profile. :zap:
zach_platform: uploading dedupe-v2 and microgold now -> s3://redwood-dev/curation/microgold/q4b-v2-1758/ ; will paste manifests when done.
lee_labelops: got it, I'll onboard two labelers to the ticket and attach rubric.
maria_ml: perfect. keep notes here if any surprises.
